messages:
maya: Quick Q — we're putting together the SOC2 folder for KMS key rotation + envelope encryption. What concrete logs and artifacts do we need to collect from AWS/GCP/Azure to prove rotations happened and RBAC changes were applied? Also any recommended naming/packaging for the evidence bundle?

Derek: For AWS, definitely export CloudTrail events for all KMS API calls around the rotation window. Important event names: CreateKey, EnableKey, DisableKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, CancelKeyDeletion, RotateKey, UpdateKeyDescription, CreateGrant, RetireGrant, RevokeGrant, GenerateDataKey, Encrypt, Decrypt.

Oliver: GCP: pull AdminActivity audit logs for `google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.*` plus the IAM Audit logs when service accounts/roles change. For Azure: collect Activity Logs and DiagnosticSettings from KeyVault (operations under `Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/*`) and the audit trail from Azure AD for role assignments.

Derek: Short commands we used in the past (one-liners to export):
```
# AWS: CloudTrail lookup for key events in a time range
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2026-01-10T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-01-12T00:00:00Z --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com
```

```
# GCP: export KMS admin activity for project to a file
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com" AND protoPayload.methodName:KeyManagementService' --project=my-project --limit=10000 --format=json > gcp_kms_admin.json
```

```
# Azure: list diagnostics for a vault
az monitor diagnostic-settings list --resource /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault>
```

oliver: Also include the KMS key metadata snapshots (key id, key version, creation/rotation timestamps) and the key policy/iam bindings at the time of rotation. For AWS use `aws kms describe-key` + `get-key-policy`, for GCP use `gcloud kms keys describe` and for Azure `az keyvault key show` and `az role assignment list` around the window.

samir: On RBAC evidence: capture policy diffs. We keep a small script that records IAM policies daily and on changes it stores a diff + who initiated the change. Example pattern: store `iam-policy-YYYYMMDD.json` and `iam-policy-YYYYMMDD.diff.txt` in S3/gs:///blob container with object metadata showing commit SHA and pipeline run id.

maya: For envelope encryption specifics what should the app-level logs include? We can't log keys or plaintext obviously.

oliver: App should log only the KMS key ID and key version used (not key material), a unique envelope id, and the ciphertext prefix/hash to tie to the object. Example fields: `{ envelope_id, kms_key_id, kms_key_version, data_key_ciphertext_sha256, operation: encrypt|decrypt, user:svc-account, request_id }`. Make sure those are immutable and included in the evidence bundle.

samir: Retention & retention proof: compliance will ask how long logs are kept and that they weren't tampered. We sign the exported bundles (CI signs the zip artifact) and include checksums + storage ACL snapshots and bucket versioning enabled. Add a short `manifest.json` with `export_time`, `sha256`, `pipeline_run`, `signed_by` fields.

security-bot: New runbook created: /runbooks/kms_rotation_audit_playbook.md — contains steps to export CloudTrail, GCP audit logs, Azure diagnostics, and how to collect app envelope metadata. :white_check_mark:

auditsquad: Packaging suggestion for SOC2 deliverable: folder structure like:
```
kms-rotation-evidence/
  metadata/manifest.json
  aws/cloudtrail_events.json
  gcp/kms_admin.json
  azure/keyvault_diagnostics.json
  snapshots/key_metadata.csv
  app/envelope_logs.csv
  signed/signature.pem
  hashes/sha256.txt
```
Include a short README.md that maps each file to the control it satisfies (e.g., CC6.1 key rotation evidence, CC4.2 RBAC change history). We also add a human-readable changelog: `rotations-historical.csv` with timestamps, actor, rotation_type (auto|manual), reason, pipeline_run.

derek: One more gotcha — CloudTrail Insight events aren't enough. If you have CloudWatch Events or EventBridge rules that trigger rotation pipelines, include the pipeline execution logs (CodePipeline/Step Functions/CloudFormation events) that show the rotation completed end-to-end. For GCP include Cloud Build runs or Terraform apply logs.

maya: This is great. Can someone own assembling the first draft of the artifact for the last planned rotation (2026-01-11) and push to `s3://compliance-snapshots/2026-01-11-kms-rotation.zip`? Need it by EOD Friday.

samir: I can take it. Will run exports, generate manifest, sign, and upload. I will post the upload link + checksum here when done.

oliver: I'll grab the GCP/Azure exports and the app envelope logs.

auditsquad: Reminder: when you upload set object ACL to restricted and enable bucket logging for access trail so we can show access history.

maya: Thanks folks. tagging @derek @samir @oliver — will follow up tomorrow with any auditor questions. :thumbsup:
